sample_unit: patients (prospective external validation across three hospitals)

links.outcome: Performance drop from internal cross-validation to prospective external multi-site data
links.effect: Internal F1 96.22%; external multi-site F1 ranged from 83.70% to 87.00% across three hospitals, attributed partly to inter-site variability in feature availability and recording protocols.
links.quote: External multi-site F1 scores ranged from 83.70% to 87.00% across all three hospitals, reflecting an expected performance reduction in prospective real-world data, partly attributed to inter-site variability in feature availability and clinical data recording protocols.

screen.reason: The study evaluates an explainable TabNet model for GDM prediction incorporating dual-stage physician-in-the-loop review with XAI explanations and multi-site clinical validation.
